questions.question: For hinge loss max(0, 1-yf(x)), what is the loss when y=1 and f(x)=0.5?
questions.explanation: The margin is y f(x)=0.5, so the hinge loss is max(0,1-0.5)=0.5.

questions.question: Which training examples are support vectors in a soft-margin linear SVM?
options: Only examples far beyond the correct margin
Examples on or inside the margin that affect the boundary
Every example with a missing feature
Only the examples in the test set
questions.explanation: Points on the margin or violating it contribute to the objective and determine the fitted boundary.

questions.question: What is the usual effect of increasing C in a soft-margin SVM?
options: All training points are discarded
The kernel is automatically changed to RBF
Misclassification is penalized more, often producing a narrower margin
The margin is forced to zero regardless of the data
questions.explanation: A larger C emphasizes training errors, allowing less violation at the cost of a less-regularized boundary.

questions.question: What does an RBF kernel provide in the SVM formulation?
options: A guarantee that every feature is standardized
A replacement for the hinge loss with cross-entropy
A method that removes all support vectors
A way to model nonlinear boundaries through pairwise similarities
questions.explanation: The kernel computes inner products in an implicit feature space, allowing nonlinear decision boundaries without constructing that space explicitly.

questions.question: Two classes are linearly separable. Which boundary does the hard-margin SVM prefer?
options: The separating boundary with the largest margin to the nearest points
The boundary that passes through the most training points
The boundary with the largest intercept
A random boundary followed by nearest-neighbor voting
questions.explanation: Maximizing the minimum distance to either class gives the maximum-margin separator.

questions.question: Your labels include a few unavoidable errors. Which SVM choice is most sensible?
options: Use a hard margin so every noisy point controls the boundary
Use a soft margin and tune C rather than demanding perfect separation
Remove the hinge loss and fit class means
Set every feature weight to one before training
questions.explanation: A soft margin permits selected violations, preventing a noisy label from forcing an extreme boundary.
